title: Visual Lead Time: Scan 10–15 Seconds Ahead (1 City Block / Quarter-Mile on Highway)

no_head_on_same_lane.note: All foreground and midground vehicles in our lane travel same direction; no opposing vehicles share a lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: No car interior or steering wheel is visible; only exterior rear view of blue sedan shown.

single_bulb_signal.note: Overhead traffic signal at top center shows two lit lenses at once: red top lens and green bottom lens both illuminated.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Blue sedan travels on right side with double-yellow centerline on its left and white edge line/curb on its right; oncoming traffic kept left.

zero_text.note: All signs, banners, license plate appear as blank geometric shapes; no letters, numbers or words visible.

scene_match.note: Shows blue sedan with cyan forward-vision arc a block ahead spotting brake lights, crosswalk pedestrian on left, and white van on right, as described.

result.summary: Scene correctly teaches forward scanning but REJECT due to traffic signal displaying red and green simultaneously, violating single-bulb rule.

teaching_correct.note: Cyan horizon arc illustrating 10-15 second visual lead with early detection of pedestrian, brake lights and van correctly teaches scanning ahead.

result.what_i_see: Rear view of a blue sedan in the right lane of an urban boulevard at sunset with a translucent cyan scanning arc projecting forward over a crosswalk pedestrian on the left, stopped cars ahead, and a white van on the right.
